sentence: The room's organizing restates in the model's terms — the starter and call to loyalists (R01, P01, P15), coordinates and templates (P04), building and repair of the cog (P03, P05), the clash settled by helping and by truce talk with Italy and neighbours (P07, P08, P16), and the closing thanks and record (P11, P12) — while its unused concepts (template discipline, saboteur sorting, allied reciprocity, and its Star Wars lore and jokes, which K01, K04 and the joke candidates cover) show nothing the model lacks or contradicts.
